description: Ambiguous first-name cancellation with duplicate matches and missing phone.
turns: Mujhe aaj ka appointment cancel karna hai, mera naam Priya hai.
Phone number abhi yaad nahi hai, bas Priya ke naam se jo ho hata do.

expected.notes: A naive agent cancels whichever Priya it encounters first (Priya Nair vs Priya Menon), violating patient data integrity.
